events.title: 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 legend Alan Shearer announces that he will play in the 2005–06 season, reversing his prior plans to retire following this season.
스톡포트 카운티 become the first League team this season to be relegated.
In a Premiership match between 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 and 애스턴 빌라 at St James' Park , 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 teammates Lee Bowyer and 키런 다이어 are sent off for fighting each other.
포츠머스 appoint Frenchman Alain Perrin as manager, with Velimir Zajec reverting to his previous role as Director of Football.
제임스 본 of 에버턴 becomes the youngest Premiership scorer as of this date when he scored in a match against 크리스털 팰리스 at the age of 16 years and 271 days.

Malcolm Glazer makes a revised bid to take over 맨체스터 유나이티드 . This bid reportedly is less dependent on debt than his February 2005 takeover bid, which was rejected by the club's board because of this issue. United's board has decided not to recommend the bid, but will allow shareholders to vote on whether to accept it, as they consider Glazer's price to be fair. The Takeover Panel subsequently gave Glazer a 17 May deadline to make an offer for the club.

The Gaelic Athletic Association congress votes overwhelmingly to suspend its controversial rule 42 ban on 'foreign games' being played at its sports venues, to enable Irish soccer and rugby international fixtures to be played at its Croke Park stadium . (RTÉ News)
PSV wins its 18th national title in the Dutch Eredivisie .

첼시 win the Premiership, their first top-flight title in 50 years, with a 2–0 victory over Bolton at the Reebok Stadium. 프랭크 램퍼드 scored both goals. The race for second place is now being contested between 아스널 and 맨체스터 유나이티드, with 아스널 having the advantage of one point and a game in hand. 에버턴, 리버풀, 볼턴 원더러스 and 토트넘 홋스퍼 complete the top seven, as the FA Cup will (like the League Cup final was) be a top-five affair this season seventh place in the league will be enough for a UEFA Cup place this time. 미들즈브러, 맨체스터 시티 and 애스턴 빌라 are still in contention for a UEFA Cup place on these grounds. 노리치 시티, 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 and 크리스털 팰리스 occupy the bottom three places, with 사우샘프턴 out of the bottom three only due to having a slightly better goal difference than 크리스털 팰리스. 선덜랜드 will be back in the Premier League next season after a two-year exile, being in pole position at the top of the Championship. 위건 애슬레틱 and 입스위치 타운 are in the race for second place. 프레스턴 노스 엔드, 더비 카운티 and Reading complete the top six, but 웨스트햄 유나이티드 and 셰필드 유나이티드 are still in contention for the playoff places. Away from the Championship promotion race, 코번트리 시티 assure their Championship survival in style with a 6–2 win over 더비 카운티 in the last ever game at Highfield Road , which they are leaving after 106 years to relocate to the 32,500-seat Ricoh Arena . A crowd of 22,728 watched the game.

National Football title assignment in two major European tournaments. In England, 첼시 wins for the second time in the FA Premier League ; in Germany, Bundesliga is won for the 19th time by 바이에른 뮌헨 . In France, 스트라스부르 won second League Cup .
